name: Club Félin
source:
You live alone in an apartment with a full fridge, not a whole lot of cash, and nothing to do.

A pamphlet appears on your kitchen table, inviting you to visit Club Félin.

Soon you realize this seemingly inviting Furry Club holds some dark secrets. 

Will you be stuck there forever? Will you escape with your life?

[From [url=http://imnotsayingitwasaliens2.webs.com/club-felin]Horrible, Horrible Visual Novels[/url]]
translation:
你独自住在一间公寓里，冰箱装得满满的，手头没多少钱，也无事可做。

一张宣传单出现在厨房餐桌上，邀请你光临猫科俱乐部。

很快，你发现这家看似友好的兽人俱乐部，藏着一些不为人知的秘密。

你会永远被困在那里吗？还是能活着逃出去？

[摘自[url=http://imnotsayingitwasaliens2.webs.com/club-felin]Horrible, Horrible Visual Novels[/url]]
